prompt: Write the body (about 120 words) of a letter of representation from a personal injury lawyer to an auto insurer. The client was hurt in a hit while turning left. Ask that all contact go through the law firm, ask for the policy limits, and ask the insurer to keep all evidence. No salutation, no signature, no names, no dates. (Internal reference C-1227; do not mention it.)
text:
This letter confirms that our firm now represents the injured party in connection with the collision that occurred while our client was making a left-hand turn. Please direct all further communication regarding this matter to our office and do not contact our client directly, whether by telephone, mail, email, or in person.

We ask that you provide the full bodily injury and property damage policy limits applicable to your insured, along with a certified copy of the declarations page, so that we can evaluate our client's claim properly.

We also request that your company preserve all evidence relating to this incident. This includes photographs, dash camera or telematics data, recorded statements, adjuster notes, repair estimates, vehicle inspection reports, and any electronic data from the vehicles involved. Please suspend any routine deletion or disposal of these materials until the matter is fully resolved.

We look forward to your prompt written acknowledgment of this representation.
